code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, INR, and mild hypoalbuminemia, suggesting significant systemic inflammation and possible coagulopathy. The pattern may indicate acute infection or inflammatory process (e.g., viral infection such as COVID-19), with risk of hypoxic and hematologic complications. Renal function is mildly impaired (creatinine elevated). Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
